label: early original-phase bigram detector: o/w/0/a (and i/t/g/c) after u/w/0/o/g/2
predicate: (phase == 0) & (t >= 1) & (t <= 3) & isin(in_tok, [tok("o"), tok("w"), tok("0"), tok("a"), tok("i"), tok("t"), tok("g"), tok("c")]) & isin(prev_tok, [tok("u"), tok("w"), tok("0"), tok("o"), tok("g"), tok("2")])
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (96% of mass), at early positions t=1..3 (92% of mass; peaks at t=1, never t=0, rare after t=4). Selective for the current input token (o, w, 0, a strongest at 3-7x lift; i, t, g, c weaker) and for the previous token (u, w, 0, o, g, 2). Prefixes starting with u or b u give the strongest activations, e.g. b u w 0 or u u o. Mostly on first occurrences of a token. It is close to silent in the delimiter and copy phases and on digits 1/2 as input. The predicate is a bigram-and-position approximation; the true dependence on token identity looks graded, so precision and recall are both about 0.5.
